title: Zachary Mason invites you to dance with newest single “The Funky Martians”
htmlContent: Zachary Mason has made a splash with his new song, "The Funky Martians." This fun and upbeat track is the second one from his upcoming EP titled "5...4...3...2...1...," and it brings a strange twist to a story about survival in space, filled with misunderstandings and lots of funky beats. "The Funky Martians" has a lot of personality. With catchy synth sounds, groovy bass, and a playful feel, Mason takes us to a world where humans are trying to settle on Mars, but things don't go as planned. Instead of a beautiful new home, they encounter some not-so-friendly Martians. Instead of a typical conflict, a funny mix-up helps everyone relax and start dancing together rather than fighting. Mason adds a touch of humor with his fun and theatrical style, making the song enjoyable and accessible. This track embraces the silly side of things, all while sounding really polished. It's like a mashup of George Clinton's funkiness and the playful lyrics of Flight of the Conchords, but with a Martian twist. "The Funky Martians" serves as a great sneak peek into what's coming next. The EP, "5...4...3...2...1...," promises to be a musical journey from a damaged Earth to outer space, with each song telling a different part of this funky adventure. https://open.spotify.com/album/04uuSXf08NReaNze8gNLOq If this single is any clue, the EP will be full of entertaining stories and catchy tunes. Zachary Mason clearly shows off his creative talent in this track. He's telling fun stories that make you want to dance. With "The Funky Martians," he has transformed a tale about moving to another planet and potential alien conflicts into a hilarious track. Zachary Mason is ready to groove, the music is great, and the idea of space exploration has never sounded funkier.
